units.source_text: “好了，我认输！……真没办法，输给他们了……”

en.t: All right, I give up! There is nothing I can do. They have beaten me.

units.source_text: 自己可不是什么晒干的沙丁鱼，决不愿就这样被他们弄死。

en.t: He was no dried-up sardine, and he had no intention of letting them kill him like this.
It was not that he had truly surrendered.

units.source_text: 可眼下，为了弄到水，就是叫他耍个把戏也愿意。

en.t: But for the moment, if it meant getting water, he was willing even to put on a little act.
